Even after receiving counsel from Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge, Congress leader Imran Masood remains unyielding in his stance. He has asserted that the party will not settle for anything less than 105 seats. Taking a dig at the Samajwadi Party (SP), he remarked that the SP would not be able to win without the Congress.
